about_the_game:
The N.O.X. team is fully committed to refining every aspect of the game. Our goal is simple: if the game isn't good enough yet, we won't stop working.

About This Game

N.O.X is a cooperative horror game where up to four players take on the roles of supernatural investigators. Your mission is to uncover evidence, identify the type of spirit haunting the location, and perform an exorcism using various tools. Whether you prefer to go solo or team up, the choice is yours.

INVESTIGATE

Your task is to find three types of evidence from a pool of seven, using seven different ghost detection devices to determine the spirit’s type.

  • 7 Types of Evidence – From invisible handprints and temperature fluctuations to eerie whispers from the other side, each piece of evidence helps reveal the entity you're facing.

  • Batteries Have a Lifespan – Some tools rely on energy, and batteries can die unexpectedly. Always keep an eye on power levels and swap out equipment before you find yourself in a dangerous situation.

  • Tool Variations – Certain tools come in multiple forms. Choosing the right tool for the situation and your playstyle will make your investigation more efficient.

BANISHING

Once you’ve gathered enough evidence to confirm the spirit's identity, it’s time to select from over 10 different exorcism methods.

  • Over 20 Unique Spirits – Each ghost has its own habits, behaviors, and special abilities. Some enjoy toying with their victims, while others pursue their prey relentlessly, making every encounter unpredictable.

  • 10+ Exorcism Methods – Each type of spirit requires a unique ritual to be banished. Some may require special incantations, while others demand the burning of cursed objects.

  • Be Careful with Your Choices! – If you perform the wrong ritual, the spirit might grow angry and hunt you down.

EXPLORE HAUNTED LOCATIONS

To ensure endless challenges, the game features a random map and house layout system, so every time you step into a haunted location, the experience will be different.

  • Changing Locations Every Time – The structure, room layout, evidence positions, and hiding spots will never be the same, forcing you to adapt with each encounter.

  • Real-Life Haunted Locations – Experience the haunting atmosphere of real-life haunted places, recreated through 3D scanning technology for an authentic and terrifying experience.

  • Stunning Graphics and Sound with Unreal Engine 5 – Powered by cutting-edge graphics technology, the game delivers sharp details, realistic lighting and shadows, and chilling soundscapes that make you feel like you're truly in a haunted place.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10400, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6G VRAM), AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6G VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: intel i7 12700k, AMD Ryzen 7 7800x3D
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (8G VRAM), AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (16GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: N.O.X is a co-op horror game where up to four players take on the roles of paranormal investigators. Players must find clues, identify the type of spirit, and banish it using their tools, either alone or together with their crew.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese
